newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW - Dentsply backs Q1 consensus.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Dentsply backs Q1 consensus.

text.p: Dentsply International Inc Chief Executive John Miles on Thursday said he was comfortable with the First Call consensus earnings estimate of $0.63 per share in the first quarter, versus $0.56 the previous year.

For 1997, the dental products manufacturer is comfortable with earnings estimates in the $2.88 to $2.89 per share range, Miles said in an interview with Reuters at a Mesirow Financial dental industry conference in Chicago.
The company earned $2.50 per share in 1996 on sales of $656.5 million. Dentsply expects 1997 revenues to exceed $750 million, Miles said.
"We should be a little north of $750 million, I think, counting the acquisitions," he said.
Dentsply has set at a target of topping $1.0 billion in sales by 2000 and expects to rely in part on acquisitions to do it.

"That requires a compound internal growth rate of about 12 percent. You have to have double-digit top-line growth or you're off the radar screen of portfolio managers," he said. "We aren't going to get top-line double-digit growth internal only, in my opinion.

"It has to be combined internal growth significantly better than market, with acquisitions. The good news is, there are plenty of acquisition opportunities to add that much volume annually to allow it to happen. It's a doable thing."
